id.description: Unique prefix for the textarea, formatting panel, and emoji picker IDs.

formAction.description: Native form submission URL for HTML and Django.

disabled.description: Disables text entry and composer actions.

allowAttachments.description: Shows the attachment button, file input, and slim FileList for files staged to send. Each picker selection adds files until the user removes them.

allowFormatting.description: Shows the formatting toggle and panel and enables formatting shortcuts.

accept.description: Accepted file types for the attachment input.

emojiPack.description: Emoji choices for the picker and typed shortcodes. An empty array hides the picker.

isThread.description: Uses reply labels and includes threadRootId when supplied.

conversationId.description: Hidden conversation ID sent with the form.

recipientId.description: Hidden recipient ID when no conversation exists.

threadRootId.description: Hidden thread root ID for replies.

recipientIds.description: Recipient IDs submitted as repeated recipientIds fields for a new conversation. Existing conversationId takes precedence.

requireRecipients.description: Require at least one recipient before sending, including associated external recipient checkboxes. Enable in a new-message flow.
